_meta.purpose: Catalog of every Common Alerts rule: per ruleset, a list of {rule_id, description, smarts}. Prefer rule_id (unique) or smarts for lookups/exclusions; do not key only by description.
pitfalls: description is NOT unique: the same text can map to multiple SMARTS (within or across rulesets)
description can be empty (DNABinder) or a numeric label (some LINT rows) or a literature code (Chelator A1/B5/…)
exclude_smarts matches exact SMARTS strings from the CSV; names alone are not enough when description is empty/ambiguous
how_to_use: Stable key: rule_id (unique across the whole catalog).
For pandas: pd.json_normalize(catalog["rulesets"][name]["rules"]) or flatten all rulesets.
For display: show description if non-empty, else smarts.
